sections.text_helper: Section 40.6.3 "Data reception stop" in chapter 40 (CSI-2 Host (CSI)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2034.
sections.section_content:
To stop data reception, set VCxSTOP = 1 in CSI_CR. The data reception stops at the end
ofthe current frame. The virtual channel status can be retrieved from VCxSTATEF
inCSI_SR0.
Note: A virtual channel cannot start before it has been completely stopped (VCxSTATEF=0
inCSI_SR0).
